info.title: Mini Banking API
info.description: Registration, JWT authentication, and account transactions. Amounts are integer currency units. All routes share a configurable concurrency limit (default 100). Request bodies are limited to 16 KiB. Unsupported account actions or methods return HTTP 400 with unsupported_action after authentication.
